tracks.title: Ring-Pull
tracks.subject: a man combing Tynemouth Longsands with a borrowed metal detector for the wedding ring he lost swimming, while his wife on the steps offers to marry him again with a ring-pull
tracks.caption: UK heartland rock in the mid-2020s North East England guitar-anthem style. A chiming Telecaster with dotted-eighth delay playing a ringing arpeggio riff; a driving eighth-note picked bass; live drums with a steady kick and open hi-hat that build into crashing choruses; a tenor saxophone answering the vocal and taking a wailing solo; a Hammond organ swelling underneath. Big but honest band-in-a-room mix, wide guitars, roomy drums, no gloss. Male tenor with a broad Geordie accent, plain-spoken in the verses, rising to a strained, open-throated high belt in the chorus. 128 BPM, D major. Windswept, tender and stubborn. No synth pads, no programmed drums, no autotune, no country twang, no pop-punk.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - chiming delay guitar, kick drum and tenor sax]

[Verse 1]
I ran into the North Sea like I was still seventeen
Came out with my hands gone numb and my wedding finger clean
Borrowed Kenny's detector and his little garden spade
Now every beep's a ring-pull or a two-p from the arcade

[Pre-Chorus]
And she's sat on the steps with a flask, shouting, love, that's enough

[Chorus]
She says, marry me again with a ring-pull
Bend it round your finger, that'll do
I'd say yes again on the Longsands
With the dog walkers watching and the lifeguard too

[Verse 2]
Three hours on the tideline and the light's gone thin and grey
Found a car key and a lighter and a penny worn away
The lifeguard's packing up his flags and asks me what I've lost
I tell him just the one thing that I swore I'd never take off

[Chorus]
She says, marry me again with a ring-pull
Twists one off her can of Coke, there, that'll do
I'd say yes again on the Longsands
She says, the gold one was always loose on you

[Bridge - sax solo, then half-time]
I said, what if it's a sign, love, losing it like that
She said, it's only metal, pet, it's not us, now put your hat on

[Chorus]
She says, marry me again with a ring-pull
I'm on one knee in the wet sand in my jeans
We both say yes at the same time
And Kenny's detector by my knee starts to beep

[Outro - guitars ringing out, sax]
Leave it, love, leave it there

tracks.title: Under-Nines
tracks.subject: a fourteen-year-old referee at a Sunday-morning under-nines football match on pitch three, shouted at by touchline dads in a league that keeps no score
tracks.caption: Nu-metal in the turn-of-the-millennium rap-metal style, as revived by mid-2020s nu-metal bands. Drop-tuned seven-string guitars chugging bouncy palm-muted riffs with dissonant high squeals; a slapped, clanky five-string bass locked to the kick drum; tight live drums with a hip-hop groove in the verses and double-kick in the choruses; a clean chorused guitar picking eerie harmonics under the pre-chorus. Dry, compressed, mid-heavy late-90s production. Male lead with rhythmic half-rapped verses, a tense sung pre-chorus and a full screamed chorus doubled by gang shouts. 96 BPM, D minor. Furious, funny, then sheepishly soft. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drops, no pop-punk, no orchestral strings.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - drop-tuned riff and live drums]

[Verse 1]
Sunday, nine a.m., pitch three, there's frost on the goal
I'm fourteen in a yellow shirt that swallows me whole
Fifteen quid in a sandwich bag, cash from the club
And a touchline full of dads in gilets gripping coffee cups

[Pre-Chorus - clean chorused guitar harmonics, tense sung]
Breathe in, count to ten
Little Alfie's sat down in the goalmouth again

[Chorus - screamed, gang shouts, double kick]
It's the under-nines, there's no table, there's no score
Sit back down in your camping chair
Fifteen quid and a whistle
I'm not paid enough for this, not paid enough for this

[Verse 2]
Steve in the gilet's screaming penalty down the line
He tripped on his own laces, Steve, he's eight, he's fine
His wife's got her phone up, filming me in portrait mode
Says it's going on the parents' WhatsApp before I get home

[Chorus - screamed, gang shouts, double kick]
It's the under-nines, there's no table, there's no score
Sit back down in your camping chair
Your lad's waving at a dog
He's not bothered, so why are you

[Bridge - half-time breakdown, gang vocals]
Final whistle, and the kids all shuffle into line
Fourteen sticky little hands, good game, ref, good game

[Chorus - half-time, clean chorused guitar, sung softly]
It's the under-nines, there's no table, there's no score
One of them hands me half his orange
And the whole touchline's gone quiet
I'm not paid enough for this, see you next week

[Outro - riff and feedback]

tracks.title: Somebody Press The Button
tracks.subject: a council events officer whose booked soap-opera vet cancels at four o'clock on the night of the town's Christmas lights switch-on, until a fourteen-year-old Labrador presses the button
tracks.caption: Broadway musical-theatre showtune, an up-tempo comic ensemble number in classic book-musical style. A brassy pit orchestra with bright trumpets and trombones punching the accents; a bouncing stride piano; sweeping strings with pizzicato under the verses; a show-drum kit on snare and brushes with rim-shot hits; sleigh bells and glockenspiel in the chorus. Clean cast-album recording, wide stereo pit, close-miked lead. Female mezzo-soprano lead with crisp diction, fast patter in the verses and a bright chest-voice belt in the chorus, a mixed ensemble chorus shouting and singing the answers. 152 BPM, B-flat major. Frantic, cheerful comic panic. No synths, no pop drum loop, no autotune, no rap, no electric guitar.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - pit orchestra fanfare and sleigh bells]

[Verse 1 - Female Lead]
Half past five in the market square, the urn is on, the stage is set
The choir's in their bobble hats, the hog roast isn't ready yet
I booked the vet off the teatime soap to come and flick the switch
At four o'clock he texted, so sorry, hun, the trains have had a hitch

[Pre-Chorus]
Two thousand people stamping in the cold
And a countdown clock that says there's ten to go

[Chorus - Ensemble and Lead]
Somebody press the button!
Somebody light the tree!
The mayor's got the flu and the vet's stuck in Crewe
And everybody's looking at me!

[Verse 2 - Female Lead]
The vicar says he'll do it if he gets to say a prayer
I've heard the vicar's prayers, we'd still be standing in the square
Councillor Platt says, me, of course, and the crowd begins to boo
Then a Labrador in a tinsel collar sits down on my shoe

[Chorus - Ensemble and Lead]
Somebody press the button!
Biscuit, paw up, one, two, three!
The mayor's got the flu and the vet's stuck in Crewe
So it's down to a dog and me!

[Bridge - Ensemble countdown over a snare roll]
Ten, nine, eight, seven, six, five, four, three, two, one!

[Chorus - Ensemble and Lead]
Somebody pressed the button!
Look at the lights on the tree!
The vet can stay in Crewe, we've got a dog who'll do
And nobody's looking at me!

[Outro - full orchestra, sleigh bells, button ending]
Same time next year, Biscuit

tracks.title: Up To My Shoulder
tracks.subject: a Mississippi Delta man noodling for a flathead catfish under a cypress log in the Sunflower River with his bare arm, and the forty-one-pound fish that bites back
tracks.caption: Raw acoustic Mississippi Delta blues in the pre-war juke-joint style, as revived in the mid-2020s. A metal-bodied resonator guitar played with a bottleneck slide in open G, the thumb thumping a droning bass string; a cupped, overblown harmonica answering each line; a heel stomping a loose shuffle on wooden boards; a low upright bass entering in the last verse. Dry, close-miked room with floor creak and a little bleed. Male baritone, gravelly and hollering, with bent blue notes, moans and a hummed refrain. 84 BPM, G major. Sweaty, boastful and rueful. No drum kit, no electric guitar, no rock beat, no gospel choir, no modern R&B polish.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - bottleneck slide guitar and foot stomp, hummed]

[Verse 1]
Sunflower River running low and brown as tea
Sunflower River running low and brown as tea
There's a flathead under that cypress log, and he's been waiting just for me

[Pre-Chorus]
Took my boots off, told my cousin, hold my hat

[Chorus]
I'm going in up to my shoulder, Lord
River up to my chin
That fish has got a mouth like a mailbox
And I'm fixing to put my whole arm in

[Verse 2]
Felt along that cypress where the water's cool and black
Felt along that cypress where the water's cool and black
Something grabbed me by the wrist like a screen door slamming back

[Chorus]
I'm in it up to my shoulder, Lord
River up to my chin
Forty pounds of flathead holding on
And I can't tell who's reeling who in

[Verse 3 - upright bass enters]
Weighed him at the bait shop, forty-one and a quarter
Weighed him at the bait shop, forty-one and a quarter
My arm looks like a chewed-up dog toy, and I'm going back for his daughter

[Instrumental Break - harmonica]

[Chorus]
I'll be in up to my shoulder, Lord
Come Saturday again
My wife says buy a rod and reel like a normal man
I say, then how'm I gonna shake hands with his kin

[Outro - hummed, slide fading]
Mm, Sunflower River, mm

tracks.title: Old Sober
tracks.subject: a yakamein seller pushing two coolers on a grocery cart four miles behind a Sunday second-line parade in New Orleans, selling old sober at every stop
tracks.caption: New Orleans second-line brass band music, Sunday street-parade style with funk in the horns. A sousaphone pumping a syncopated bass line; a bass drum with a cymbal on top and a crisp parade snare playing rolling second-line beats; two trumpets trading riffs; trombones with growling smears; a tenor saxophone filling the gaps. Live street-parade sound, loud and roomy, horns bleeding into each other, hand claps. Male lead with a gruff, joyous street-shout delivery and gang call-and-response from the band. 108 BPM, B-flat major. Hot, rowdy and joyful. No drum machine, no synth bass, no electric guitar, no autotune, no hip-hop beat.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - parade snare roll, sousaphone line and trumpet call]

[Verse 1]
Sunday, one o'clock, the club comes stepping out the door
Green sashes, white shoes, and the tuba starts to roar
I got two coolers on a grocery cart, a ladle and a stack of cups
I walk four miles behind the band till the whole route's eaten up

[Pre-Chorus]
Band stops at the corner bar, I park it on the curb
Lift the lid and let the steam go up, I don't say a word

[Chorus - call and response]
Old sober! (Old sober!)
Beef and noodles, half an egg on top
Hot sauce, soy and a little green onion
Old sober, eight dollars a cup

[Verse 2]
Girl from out of town says, mister, is that ramen in a cup?
I said, sugar, ramen never got a tuba player up
Grand marshal's nephew been out dancing since Friday night
One spoon on the neutral ground and his knees came back to life

[Chorus - call and response]
Old sober! (Old sober!)
Snare drum wants one, trombone wants two
Hot sauce, soy and a little green onion
Old sober, I got one for you

[Bridge - drum break, sousaphone solo, gang vocals]
Where the yakamein man at? (Right behind the band!)
Where the yakamein man at? (Ladle in his hand!)

[Chorus - call and response]
Old sober! (Old sober!)
Sun's going down at the last stop
I scrape the cooler for the trumpet man
Old sober, on the house, last cup

[Outro - full band vamp, crowd claps]

tracks.title: Kaos Keramat
tracks.subject: a Persib supporter in Bandung who has not washed his knock-off blue jersey through nine unbeaten home games, while his boarding-house mates leave cream detergent outside his door
tracks.caption: Bandung punk rock in the raw 70s three-chord style of Dongker, fast and scrappy. One electric guitar bright and shimmering on open strummed chords, a second gritty overdriven guitar bashing straight downstrokes; a pick-played bass running eighth notes; rumbling live drums with floor-tom fills and a crash on every chorus downbeat; gang shouts on the bridge. Garage-room recording, close-miked amps, loose and slightly ragged, no polish. Male vocal, gritty and nasal, half-shouted and sometimes nearly off-key, in a Bandung street register. 168 BPM, E major. Rowdy, stubborn and self-mocking. No pop-punk polish, no palm-muted breakdown, no screamo, no synths, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - drum count-in and raw guitar]

[Verse 1]
Kaos biru KW dari depan GBLA
Kupakai pas menang tiga-nol, sejak itu nggak kucuci
Sembilan laga kandang belum pernah kalah
Empat bulan juga baunya makin jadi

[Pre-Chorus]
Anak kos rapat darurat di depan kamar mandi
Sabun colek ditaruh di depan pintuku

[Chorus]
Kaos keramat, jangan dicuci
Baunya kuat, Persib menang lagi
Kaos keramat, jemur di genteng
Minggu depan kupakai lagi ke tribun

[Verse 2]
Pacarku nggak mau dibonceng lagi
Katanya helmnya ikut bau keringat tribun
Driver ojol cancel pas lihat aku di gerbang
Cuma kucing tetangga yang masih mau deket-deket

[Pre-Chorus]
Terus Sabtu tandang, nol-dua, hujan, wasit buta
Satu kosan teriak, cuci sekarang, sekarang juga

[Chorus]
Kaos keramat, bukan salah dia
Salah wasit, salah rumput, salah cuaca
Kaos keramat, nggak bakal kucuci
Minggu depan kita balas di kandang sendiri

[Bridge - gang shouts and floor toms]
Biru, biru, satu kosan pakai masker
Biru, biru, aku tetap duduk paling depan

[Outro - feedback and one last crash]
Ibu kos bilang, ini teh kosan, bukan markas
Kujawab, atuh Bu, cuma sampai akhir musim

tracks.title: Padel Jam Enam
tracks.subject: four girlfriends on a six a.m. padel court in South Jakarta, three of them there for the photos and the narrator there to win
tracks.caption: Indonesian keyboard-led power pop in the Vierratale style, bright and quick. A grand piano hammering eighth-note chords as the main riff; a polysynth lead answering the vocal in short bright phrases; crunchy electric guitars opening up on the choruses; a punchy picked bass; tight live drums with handclaps on the bridge. Clean, glossy band production, piano up front, guitars wide. Female lead vocal, clear and bright in the mid register, chatty and teasing in the verses, belting the chorus. 136 BPM, A major. Bouncy, cheeky and competitive. No EDM drop, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no pop-punk palm-muting, no ballad breakdown.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - piano riff and drums]

[Verse 1]
Lapangan jam enam, disewa dua jam
Semua pakai rok putih, kayak seragam
Sepatu baru, labelnya belum dicopot
Yang lain sibuk cari angle buat story

[Pre-Chorus]
Aku nonton tutorial sampai jam dua pagi
Aku ke sini mau menang, bukan buat mejeng

[Chorus]
Padel jam enam, servis dari bawah pinggang
Bola mantul di kaca, kalian malah pose bareng
Padel jam enam, aku serius, beneran
Satu set dulu, abis itu terserah kalian

[Verse 2]
Skor dua-lima, Sasha masih pegang HP
Rina di seberang nanya filter yang bikin kaki jenjang
Dita sibuk benerin kuncir di depan kaca
Aku lari sendirian dari pojok ke pojok

[Pre-Chorus]
Tiba-tiba Sasha taruh HP di bangku
Oke, oke, ayo, sini bolanya

[Chorus]
Padel jam enam, servis dari bawah pinggang
Sasha smash keluar pagar, Rina sama Dita bengong
Padel jam enam, ujung-ujungnya kalah juga, sih
Tapi yang diposting malah fotoku pas jatuh

[Bridge - synth lead and handclaps]
Tiga ratus ribu sejam, dibagi berempat
Mahal, tapi kapan lagi lihat Sasha keringetan

[Outro - piano riff, drums stop]
Minggu depan jam enam lagi?
Boleh, tapi HP dikumpulin di tas

tracks.title: Dadak Merak
tracks.subject: a young pembarong in Ponorogo training to hold the fifty-kilogram dadak merak peacock mask by his teeth, three weeks before the Grebeg Suro festival
tracks.caption: Reog Ponorogo gamelan pop, the East Javanese reog street ensemble carrying a sung song. A slompret double-reed shawm playing a piercing, wailing lead line; kendang and ketipung drums driving fast interlocking patterns with sharp slaps and cue breaks; kempul and kenong on the off-beats with a big gong closing every cycle; angklung reog rattling in tight bursts; a plain electric bass doubling the gong tones. Open-air and loud, close-miked like a troupe recorded in a village hall yard. Young male tenor vocal, bright and strained, chanting the verses and shouting the chorus, with a group of male and female voices answering. 132 BPM, D minor. Sweaty, proud and rowdy. No koplo drum machine, no dangdut suling, no campursari keyboard, no EDM drop, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - kendang roll and slompret]

[Verse 1]
Lima puluh kilo, kepala macan, bulu merak
Kugigit kayu di dalamnya, leherku jadi tiang
Pak Warok hitung pakai jari, baru sampai dua belas
Rahangku gemetar, keringat masuk ke mata

[Pre-Chorus]
Anak-anak jathil cekikikan di bawah pohon sawo
Mas, merakmu miring ke kiri lagi

[Chorus - male lead with group shouts]
Angkat, angkat, dadak merak
Gigit yang kuat, jangan sampai rebah
Kendang makin cepat, slompret makin nyaring
Grebeg Suro tinggal tiga minggu lagi

[Verse 2]
Tiap sore latihan di belakang balai desa
Bujang Ganong salto, aku cuma bisa muter
Bapak-bapak warung kopi ikut kasih saran
Pundaknya, Le, pundaknya, jangan cuma gigi

[Pre-Chorus]
Malam ini Pak Warok hitung sampai enam puluh
Aku masih berdiri, merak masih tegak

[Chorus - male lead with group shouts]
Angkat, angkat, dadak merak
Gigit yang kuat, biar alun-alun bergetar
Kendang makin cepat, slompret makin nyaring
Grebeg Suro, ayo, gigiku sudah siap

[Bridge - kendang break and group shouts]
Ganong, jathil, warok, semua masuk lingkaran
Satu, dua, tiga, merak diangkat lebih tinggi

[Outro - slompret alone, one gong]
Rahangku pegal sampai pagi
Tapi bulu meraknya utuh semua

tracks.title: Bas deng Melodi
tracks.subject: a married couple in a Tomohon church kolintang group, she on the melody bars at one end of the row and he on the bass box at the other, cueing each other across the hall at Thursday rehearsals
tracks.caption: Minahasa kolintang ensemble pop from North Sulawesi, a church-hall wooden xylophone band playing a love song. A melody kolintang carrying the tune in quick tremolo rolls on bright wooden bars; alto and tenor kolintang filling the chords in broken patterns; a cello kolintang walking a counter-line; a big bass kolintang thumping round low notes from its wooden box resonator; a steel-string ukulele strumming the off-beats. Airy community-hall room recording, all wood and mallet attack. Warm female alto vocal, gentle and conversational with a Manado accent, a male baritone joining in harmony on the last chorus. 96 BPM, F major. Tender, teasing and settled. No drum kit, no synth pads, no gamelan, no dangdut groove, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - melody kolintang alone]

[Verse 1]
Tiap Kamis malam di aula gereja
Kita di ujung kiri, pegang kolintang melodi
Ngana di ujung kanan, di belakang peti bas
Dua belas taon so bagini, nyanda pernah tukar tampa

[Pre-Chorus]
Opa Dirk angka tangan, torang mulai
Ngana cuma lia pa kita, nyanda lia not angka

[Chorus]
Kalu kita ketuk dua kali, ngana masuk
Bas deng melodi, dari ujung ka ujung
Orang bilang torang dua jauh skali
Padahal cuma sepuluh langkah deng satu lagu

[Verse 2]
Ngana pe pemukul bas so dibungkus karet baru
Kita pe tangan so ada urat, mar masih cepat
Ngana salah masuk, kong ngana senyum pa kita
Kita pura-pura mara, mar kita ikut senyum

[Bridge - bass and cello kolintang alone]
Satu kali ngana demam, anak SMP ganti ngana
Lagu jalan trus, mar kita salah masuk tiga kali

[Pre-Chorus]
Abis latihan, ngana so kase hidup motor
Singgah beli goroho goreng deng dabu-dabu

[Chorus - with male harmony]
Kalu kita ketuk dua kali, ngana masuk
Bas deng melodi, dari ujung ka ujung
Natal nanti torang main di depan jemaat
Kita mo lia pa ngana, bukan pa Opa Dirk

[Outro - melody kolintang, slowing]
Kita ketuk dua kali
Dari ujung sana, ngana balas

tracks.title: Sarapan di Bibir Kawah
tracks.subject: a Rinjani porter from Sembalun cooking banana pancakes on the crater rim at dawn while his trekkers go up to the summit
tracks.caption: Indonesian Britpop-style alternative pop in the 2000s Nidji arena manner, Coldplay and Killers lineage. A clean electric guitar with dotted-eighth delay ringing a repeating figure; a second overdriven guitar opening wide on the choruses; grand piano pounding quarter-note chords; driving eighth-note bass and big open live drums with floor-tom builds. Wide arena-sized mix with a long plate reverb on the snare. Male tenor vocal, clear and lifted, restrained in the verses and opening into a full-throated chorus. 124 BPM, D major. Wide-open, proud and grateful. No EDM drop, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no pop-punk palm-muting, no ballad slowdown.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - delay guitar and piano]

[Verse 1]
Jam dua pagi tamu-tamu berangkat ke puncak
Aku tinggal di bibir kawah sama kompor dan wajan
Tiga puluh lima kilo kubawa kemarin dari Sembalun
Pakai sandal jepit, bambu di bahu, lagu dangdut di saku

[Pre-Chorus]
Adonan pisang kuaduk pelan-pelan
Kabut masih menutup Segara Anak

[Chorus]
Ini sarapan di bibir kawah
Pancake pisang, teh manis, gulanya dua sendok
Kalian pulang bawa foto dari puncak
Aku di sini lihat danau bangun duluan

[Verse 2]
Tiga ratus kali aku naik gunung ini
Kakiku hafal batu mana yang suka goyang
Anakku di rumah minta oleh-oleh gantungan kunci
Kubilang, bapak cuma bawa pulang bau asap

[Pre-Chorus]
Jaket warna-warni turun dari puncak
Kuangkat wajan, kubalik yang pertama

[Chorus]
Ini sarapan di bibir kawah
Pancake pisang, sedikit gosong di pinggir
Kalian bilang ini paling enak sedunia
Padahal cuma lapar dan udara tipis

[Bridge - guitars swell, drums half-time]
Besok kubawa turun semuanya lagi
Panci, tenda, sampah kalian, sampai ke gerbang desa

[Outro - piano and delay guitar]
Danau sudah bangun
Wajan masih hangat

tracks.title: 君の天気予報
tracks.subject: a man who watches his girlfriend present the local evening weather forecast every night and leaves his umbrella at home whenever she says it will be fine, even after she got it wrong and he came home soaked
tracks.caption: Japanese band ballad with strings in the mid-2020s rock-trio style, a slow love song carried by a guitar band. Clean electric guitar playing arpeggiated open chords with light chorus; warm electric bass holding long root notes; live drums with soft rimclicks in the verses opening to a full kit with crash cymbals in the chorus; a real string section entering at the first chorus with sustained violins and a cello counter-line; upright piano doubling the chorus chords. Polished but natural studio sound, roomy drums, strings wide behind the band, vocal upfront with medium plate reverb. Male tenor, gentle and conversational in the verses, opening into a clear high chest voice in the chorus with no showy runs. 76 BPM, E-flat major. Tender, grateful and quietly happy. No trap beat, no EDM drop, no autotune, no rap, no orchestral bombast.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - clean electric guitar arpeggio and soft piano]

[Verse 1]
六時五十分 テレビの中で
君が天気図の 前に立つ
今朝ふたりで 迷ったジャケット
紺にしといて 正解だった

[Pre-Chorus]
僕らの町を ペンでとんとん
二回叩くのは 僕への合図

[Chorus]
明日は晴れると 君が言うから
傘は玄関に 置いていく
当たるかどうかは どうでもいい
君が言うなら 晴れでいい

[Verse 2]
先週の木曜は 見事に外れて
駅から家まで 僕はずぶ濡れ
あとで帰った君は 濡れた靴を見て
「ごめん」と言いながら 笑い転げた

[Pre-Chorus]
天気図よりも 僕の機嫌を
当てるほうが 得意なくせに

[Chorus]
明日は晴れると 君が言うから
傘は玄関に 置いていく
もし降ったら それも悪くない
君のせいに できるから

[Bridge - strings swell, drums drop out]
町じゅうが見てる 三分間の君より
玄関で靴を脱ぐ 君が好きだ

[Outro - clean guitar and strings, fading]
明日の南部は 晴れ
君がそう言うなら 晴れ

tracks.title: 行かないで焼き芋屋さん
tracks.subject: running out in sandals on a winter Friday night after the stone-baked sweet-potato truck's loudspeaker call and finally catching it at the shrine slope for the last 800-yen potato
tracks.caption: Japanese Latin-kayo dance pop, a modern dance-floor take on Showa-era Latin kayo with a cha-cha rhythm section. Congas and timbales driving a cha-cha groove with cowbell on the beat; piano playing a syncopated montuno figure; a trumpet and trombone section blasting short unison riffs between the sung lines; nylon-string guitar strumming tight Latin chords; electric bass on a tumbao pattern. Bright, punchy studio mix with the percussion wide and the horns forward, retro plate reverb on the voice. Male baritone lead with theatrical kayo vibrato and a melodramatic delivery, female backing voices answering the chorus lines. 126 BPM, A minor. Comic melodrama, wistful but danceable. No reggaeton dembow beat, no trap drums, no autotune, no EDM synths, no distorted rock guitar.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - congas, timbales and a trumpet fanfare]

[Verse 1]
金曜の夜 パジャマのまま
こたつでみかんを むいてたら
遠くで「いしやーきいも」の声
窓を開けたら 角を曲がってく

[Pre-Chorus]
サンダル突っかけ 財布をつかみ
冬の路地へ 走り出す

[Chorus - male lead, female backing voices answer]
行かないで 焼き芋屋さん
次の角で 待っていて
かじかむ指に ひとつだけ
あったかいのを ちょうだい

[Verse 2]
神社の坂で やっと追いつき
息を切らして 手を挙げる
おじさんが 秤にのせて
「最後の一本 八百円」

[Pre-Chorus]
一瞬止まって 財布をのぞき
小銭を全部 かき集め

[Chorus - male lead, female backing voices answer]
ありがとう 焼き芋屋さん
八百円でも 悔いはない
新聞紙ごと 胸に抱いて
坂道ゆっくり 帰ります

[Outro - horns and timbales, final stab]
行かないで 焼き芋屋さん
来週もまた 呼びに来てね
金曜の夜 待ってるから

tracks.title: 一音目で払ってやる
tracks.subject: a first-year in a high-school competitive karuta club at the July tournament at Ōmi Jingū, sweeping cards across the tatami before the reader finishes the first syllable, against a smug third-year from a rival school who sneered at her
tracks.caption: Japanese para para Eurobeat in the Super Eurobeat tradition, the high-speed dance style Tokyo para para dancers move to. A four-on-the-floor kick with offbeat open hi-hats and a snare on two and four; a galloping octave synth bass in sixteenth notes; a bright brassy FM-synth lead playing the hook riff; orchestra-hit stabs closing each phrase; a sawtooth synth arpeggio running under the verses. Loud, compressed 2000s club mix, synths wide, vocal centered with a short delay. Female voice, strong high chest voice, racing and defiant in the verses and belting the chorus. 156 BPM, F minor. Breathless, defiant and funny. No dubstep drop, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no rap verse, no guitar solo.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - octave synth bass and brassy synth riff]

[Verse 1]
七月の近江神宮 広い畳
白い靴下で 正座する
向かいは他校の 三年生
「一年か」って 鼻で笑った

[Pre-Chorus]
暗記の十五分 にらみ返して
札の場所なら 全部入った

[Chorus]
一音目で 払ってやる
読手の「む」が 終わる前に
畳の上を 札が飛ぶ
あんたの陣まで 払ってやる

[Verse 2]
「すみのえの」は 「す」で取った
「せをはやみ」は あっちへ送る
三年の指は 空を切って
お手つきひとつ 耳まで赤い

[Pre-Chorus]
飛ばした札が 審判のひざ
「すみません」って 次 行くよ

[Chorus]

tracks.title: 片耳のトラ
tracks.subject: a one-eared ginger stray who rules a shopping street meeting a fluffy white house cat on a pink harness outside the croquette shop, and hiding behind the shop girl's legs
tracks.caption: Japanese hybrid rockabilly in the neo-rockabilly style of Tokyo's live-house scene. Upright bass played slap style with a percussive click on every beat; hollow-body electric guitar with heavy slapback echo playing twangy fingerpicked fills and one short solo; a minimal drum kit of snare and kick, tight backbeat on two and four; handclaps in the stop-time break. Dry, live-in-the-room recording with tape slapback on the voice and the guitar. Female voice, sassy and husky in the low-mid range, hiccuping rockabilly phrasing and quick spoken asides. 172 BPM, E major. Cocky, swaggering and comic. No punk distortion, no synths, no autotune, no modern pop drums, no ballad section.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - slap upright bass and twangy slapback guitar]

[Verse 1]
夕方四時の 商店街
片耳のトラが 歩いてく
肉屋のおばちゃん 切れ端投げて
八百屋の親父も 道をあける

[Chorus]
よう トラ 今日もいい顔
この通りは あんたのもんだ
肩で風切って 尻尾をぴんと
誰にも道は 譲らない

[Instrumental Break - hollow-body guitar solo with slapback echo over slap upright bass]

[Verse 2]
ところが今日は ピンクのハーネス
真っ白でふわふわの 猫が来た
うちのコロッケ屋の 前で鉢合わせ
商店街じゅうが 息をのむ

[Bridge - stop-time, slap bass and handclaps]
白いのが 小さく「シャーッ」
トラは あたしの足の後ろ

[Chorus]
よう トラ どうした その顔
この通りは あんたのもんだろ
尻尾を巻いて 隠れてる
まあ 今日だけは 譲ってやりな

[Outro - guitar twang and bass slap, abrupt end]
明日も四時に 来なよ トラ

tracks.title: シナノキの六月
tracks.subject: an urban beekeeper who keeps hives on the roof of a Ginza department store, lifting the frames at noon above the lunchtime crowds and tasting the honey turn minty when the street's linden trees flower in June
tracks.caption: Japanese bossa nova in the soft Brazilian-inspired style of Tokyo bossa nova singers. Nylon-string guitar playing the classic bossa batida with major-seventh and ninth chords; brushes swept on the snare with a quiet cross-stick rim click; upright bass on soft two-feel roots and fifths; an alto flute answering the vocal lines; light Rhodes electric piano comping in the chorus. Intimate close-mic acoustic recording, low volume, warm small room, almost no reverb. Female voice, breathy and soft in a low-mid register, sung almost at speaking volume. 128 BPM, F major. Gentle, wry and unhurried. No pop drums, no synth pads, no autotune, no string swells, no samba percussion section.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - nylon-string guitar batida and brushed snare]

[Verse 1]
昼の十二時 デパートの屋上
「関係者以外」の 扉の向こう
面布をかぶって ふたを開けると
巣枠いっぱいに 蜂が歩く

[Chorus]
下の通りは お昼休み
ランチの列が 角まで続く
巣箱に煙を ふわりとかけて
一枚ずつ 枠を上げる

[Verse 2]
六月になって 通りのシナノキ
小さな花が 咲きはじめた
指ですくった 蜜をなめると
先週よりも すっとして甘い

[Chorus]
下の通りは お昼休み
誰も見上げや しないけど
今日の蜜には シナノキの花
銀座の六月を 舌にのせる

[Bridge - alto flute and Rhodes]
四丁目の信号を 人は待つ
蜂は待たずに まっすぐ渡る

[Outro - guitar alone, slowing]
来週は どんな味がするかな

tracks.caption: K-pop techno in the 2026 idol style, a driving club track with a cool, half-spoken girl-group topline. A pounding four-on-the-floor 909 kick; a squelching 303 acid bassline that opens its filter into the chorus; rolling off-beat open hi-hats with a clap on two and four; stabbing minor-key rave synth chords; a metallic arcade-style bleep sequence answering the vocal lines. Dark warehouse mix, kick and acid line forward, dry vocal with a short slapback delay. Female mid-range voice, cool and talky in the verses, shouted unison chorus. 140 BPM, F minor. Breathless, cheeky and rowdy. No trap hi-hats, no EDM festival drop, no autotune, no rap verse, no dubstep wobble.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - pounding kick and acid bassline]

[Verse 1]
열두 시 반, 제이공학관 앞
하얀 배달 로봇 삼 호
제육덮밥 싣고 오다가
또 그 턱에 걸렸어

[Pre-Chorus]
바퀴는 헛돌고 눈은 깜빡깜빡
"잠시만 기다려 주세요"

[Chorus - unison group shout]
하나 둘 셋, 영차 영차
앞바퀴 들어, 뒤에서 밀어
덜컹 넘어간다, 삼 호야
점심마다 우리가 밀어

[Verse 2]
과잠 입은 애들이 모여
커피 들고 구경 와
누구는 폰으로 찍고
누구는 박자 맞춰 박수 쳐

[Pre-Chorus]
오 센티 턱 하나 고쳐 달라고
민원 넣은 지 벌써 한 달

[Chorus - unison group shout]
하나 둘 셋, 영차 영차
기계과는 들고, 전자과는 밀어
덜컹 넘어간다, 삼 호야

tracks.title: 왼쪽 굽
tracks.genre: Korean boom bap with psych-rock guitar
tracks.subject: the old man in the shoe-repair booth at a subway exit who reads a young job-seeker's habits from his worn left heel while re-heeling his only dress shoes the night before an interview
tracks.caption: Korean boom bap with a psychedelic rock edge, in the 2025 idol hip-hop vein. A dusty swung drum break with a hard snare crack and loose ride cymbal; a fuzzed 1960s-style psych-rock guitar riff looped with tape warble; a round electric bass locked to the kick; a Hammond organ swelling under the hook; sparse turntable scratches on the guitar riff between sections. Warm vinyl-grain mix, drums and guitar loop forward, dry vocals. Male baritone rapper, conversational and wry storytelling flow, half-sung on the hook. 90 BPM, C minor. Wry, warm and head-nodding. No trap hi-hats, no 808 slides, no autotune, no EDM synths, no pop chorus.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - dusty drum break and fuzzy guitar loop]

[Verse 1]
삼 번 출구 계단 옆에 철제 박스 한 칸
문 위에 붙은 종이엔 굽갈이 팔천 원
작년 졸업식 때 산 구두 한 켤레
내일 면접인데 굽에서 쇳소리가 나

[Pre-Chorus]
아저씨는 안경을 이마에 올리고
구두를 뒤집어 한참을 봐

[Chorus]
"왼쪽 굽만 닳았네, 가방은 오른쪽
걸음은 빠른데 자꾸 땅만 보지"
망치 소리 세 번, 본드 냄새 한 번
"내일은 고개 들고 걸어"

[Verse 2]
그 좁은 데 다 있어, 라디오, 커피믹스
벽에는 이름표 붙은 구두 스무 켤레
"넥타이 처음 맨 애들 다 여기 앉았다 가
어제는 은행 지점장 굽도 내가 갈았어"

[Pre-Chorus]
구두약 바르고 헝겊으로 문질러
내 얼굴이 비칠 때까지

[Chorus]
왼쪽 굽만 닳았던 구두가 반짝
팔천 원 내밀었더니 오천 원만 받아
망치 소리 세 번, 본드 냄새 한 번
"붙어도 오고 떨어져도 와"

[Outro - guitar loop and scratches fade]
계단 올라가면서 소리 들어 봤어
또각, 또각, 고개 들고

tracks.title: 정오의 갈매기
tracks.subject: a stand-off on an island car-ferry deck at noon between a woman holding one bag of shrimp crackers and a seagull standing on one leg on the rail, which wins the last cracker when she only pretends to throw it
tracks.caption: Spaghetti-western idol pop, a cinematic K-pop girl-group track built on Morricone-style western scoring. A twangy baritone electric guitar with heavy tremolo and spring reverb; fast flamenco-style nylon-string guitar strums; a lone mariachi trumpet answering each vocal line; galloping tom-heavy drums with a cracking snare and tambourine; deep bell hits on the first beat of the chorus. Wide cinematic mix, dry punchy drums against a big hall reverb on the trumpet. Female mid-range lead, deadpan and mock-serious in the verses, unison gang shout on the chorus. 124 BPM, D minor. Mock-heroic, comic and tense. No EDM drop, no synth bass, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no banjo line-dance country, no rap verse.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - twangy guitar, galloping drums and a lone trumpet]

[Verse 1]
열두 시 정각, 섬 가는 배
갑판 위엔 바람하고 나
손에 든 건 과자 한 봉지
난간 위엔 너 하나

[Pre-Chorus]
한쪽 다리로 버티는 녀석
눈빛이 아주 서부극이야

[Chorus - unison gang shout]
움직이지 마, 갈매기
이건 내 거야, 새우깡
한 발짝만 와 봐, 꽉 쥘 거야
정오의 갑판, 너하고 나

[Verse 2]
옆에 꼬마가 한 개 던지자
하늘에서 서른 마리가 내려와
나는 봉지를 등 뒤로 숨겨
너는 꼼짝 않고 날 봐

[Pre-Chorus]
선착장 보일 때까지 십 분
누가 먼저 눈을 깜빡일까

[Chorus - unison gang shout]
움직이지 마, 갈매기
마지막 한 개, 새우깡
던지는 척만 했는데 낚아채
정오의 갑판, 내가 졌어

[Outro - trumpet and twang ring out]
다음 배에서 또 보자, 외다리
그땐 두 봉지 들고 올게

tracks.subject: a whole Sunday lost in a jjimjilbang, going back and forth between the eighty-degree charcoal kiln room and the ice room until the wall clock and the TV reruns stop making sense
tracks.caption: Korean psychedelic art rock in the style of Seoul's 2020s indie band scene, a hazy mid-tempo guitar-band track. Two electric guitars, one droning through a phaser and fuzz, one picking a bent, reverb-soaked melody; a melodic bass sliding under the vocal; loose floor-tom-heavy drums that lock into a heavy half-time groove on the chorus; a wobbling analog synth drone and a Mellotron flute line. Hazy, saturated mix with tape echo and wide stereo panning, the guitars swirling into a fuzz build in the bridge. Soft male tenor, drowsy and close in the verses, sliding up into falsetto on the chorus. 100 BPM, E minor. Drowsy, warped and quietly funny. No shoegaze wash, no trap, no autotune, no ballad piano, no EDM synths.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - phased guitar drone and slow floor tom]

[Verse 1]
일요일 아침 열 시에 들어왔어
수건으로 양머리를 만들고
숯가마 문을 밀면 팔십 도
모래시계를 뒤집어 놔

[Pre-Chorus]
둥근 황토 천장이
천천히 돌기 시작해

[Chorus]
녹는다, 녹아, 벽시계도
뜨거운 데서 차가운 데로
식혜 한 모금, 맥반석 계란
몇 시인지 묻지 마

[Verse 2]
얼음방에 누우면 귀가 울려
옆 아저씨 코 고는 소리가
베이스처럼 바닥에 깔려
티비에선 아까 그 드라마가 또 해

[Pre-Chorus]
발끝이 하얗게 시려
다시 숯가마로 기어가

[Chorus]
녹는다, 녹아, 일요일도
뜨거운 데서 차가운 데로
계란 껍질이 손톱 밑에
몇 시인지 묻지 마

[Bridge - guitars swirl into fuzz, voice drenched in echo]
손목에 찬 옷장 열쇠가
아직도 따뜻해

[Outro - feedback and drone fade]
밖에 나오니 깜깜해
월요일이 문 앞에 서 있어

tracks.title: 제일 단 거
tracks.subject: two seasonal tangerine pickers on a Seogwipo farm in December who fall for each other; she peels one tangerine from every tenth crate behind the owner's back and splits it with him, always handing over the sweeter half
tracks.caption: Korean lovers rock reggae, a slow one-drop love song. One-drop drums with a rimshot click and the kick on the third beat; a deep, round electric bass carrying the melody; an off-beat skank guitar with short muted strums; a bubbling Hammond organ; a melodica playing the answer lines. Warm analog mix, bass heavy and centred, light spring reverb, a touch of dub delay on the snare at section ends. Sweet female mid-range voice, light and smiling, soft male harmony on the chorus. 74 BPM, A major. Tender, sunny and shy. No dancehall beat, no reggaeton, no ska horns, no trap, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - one-drop drums, skank guitar and melodica]

[Verse 1]
십이월 서귀포, 귤밭 알바
가위 하나, 노란 상자
옆 줄에서 너는 자꾸
꼭지를 길게 남겨 혼나

[Pre-Chorus]
사장님 몰래 한 개 까서
반은 내 입에, 반은 너한테

[Chorus - female lead, soft male harmony]
제일 단 건 너 줄게
상자 열 개에 하나씩
손톱 밑이 노래져도
제일 단 건 너한테만

[Verse 2]
점심엔 밭 끝 돌담에 앉아
바람 피해서 컵라면
네 장갑 한 짝이 구멍 나서
내 걸 한 짝 끼워 줬지

[Pre-Chorus]
돌아갈 비행기 표는
둘 다 아직 안 끊었어

[Chorus - female lead, soft male harmony]
제일 단 건 너 줄게
남은 줄이 몇 개든
손바닥까지 노래져도
제일 단 건 너한테만

[Outro - bass and melodica fading]
내일도 같은 줄에 서자
가위 소리 맞춰서

tracks.title: Tuala Merah
tracks.mood: tender, proud and a little lovesick
tracks.subject: a tower-crane operator on a Bukit Jalil building site who watches his flat through cheap binoculars from the cab forty storeys up, where his wife hangs a red towel on the balcony rail at noon every day
tracks.caption: Romantic bolero, a slow Latin ballad with mariachi trumpets. A nylon-string requinto guitar playing ornamented runs between the lines; a second nylon guitar strumming the bolero rhythm; bongos and maracas keeping the bolero pattern soft and steady; two mariachi trumpets answering in thirds at the end of each chorus; a string section holding long notes and swelling into the choruses. Warm live-room recording, guitars and voice close, trumpets slightly back with a natural hall tail, strings soft and wide. Male baritone crooner, warm and close to the mic, stretching phrases with gentle rubato and opening up in the chorus. 80 BPM, A minor. Tender, proud and a little lovesick, forty storeys up. No piano, no trap beat, no reggaeton dembow, no autotune, no synth pads, no rock drum kit.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - requinto guitar run and soft strings]

[Verse 1]
Pukul tujuh aku panjat tangga besi
Empat puluh tingkat, langit KL masih kelabu
Dari kabin kren semua nampak kecil
Lori simen, topi kuning, kereta beratur

[Pre-Chorus]
Teropong murah beli kat Petaling Street
Aku cari tingkat sembilan, balkoni ketiga

[Chorus]
Tuala merah di pagar balkoni
Kau sidai tepat tengah hari
Orang lain nampak kain basah
Aku dengar, "Abang, saya kat sini"

[Verse 2]
Isnin lepas hujan turun dari subuh
Kerja berhenti, aku duduk dalam kabin
Pukul dua belas aku tak harap apa-apa
Tapi merah itu naik juga, basah lencun

[Chorus]
Tuala merah di pagar balkoni
Kau sidai juga dalam hujan lebat
Orang lain nampak kain basah
Aku dengar, "Abang, saya tunggu"

[Bridge - trumpets and strings swell]
Hari ni ada kain lain kat sebelah
Mandur panggil, aku langsung tak dengar

[Chorus]
Tuala merah di pagar balkoni
Dan sehelai baju kecil warna putih
Orang lain nampak kain basah
Aku dengar, "Abang, kita dah bertiga"

[Outro - requinto guitar and trumpets, fading]

tracks.title: Pangkah!
tracks.subject: a 19-year-old at a gasing pangkah (striking-top) contest at the Gelanggang Seni in Kota Bharu, Kelantan, who keeps knocking his uncles' tops out of the ring, talks trash between throws, and leaves his own top spinning longer than the emcee's patience lasts
tracks.caption: Brazilian funk phonk in the funk mandelão style, rapped in Malay. A tamborzão drum pattern with a booming kick, a hard clap-snare and tumbling hand-drum fills; a distorted sub-bass punching on the off-beats; a detuned phonk cowbell playing a short repeating melody; brass-synth stabs on the downbeat of each hook. Loud, dry and compressed mix, bass and cowbell forward, shouts spread wide. Male rapper-chanter in a mid register, punchy half-rapped verses with a grin in the voice, a crew of men shouting the hook back. 130 BPM, F minor. Cocky, cheeky and loud, a whole gelanggang's grudging respect. No trap hi-hat rolls, no boom-bap beat, no autotune, no sung pop chorus, no reggaeton dembow, no EDM build-up.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - cowbell melody and sub-bass hits]

[Verse 1]
Gelanggang Seni Kota Bharu, petang Sabtu
Pak Su, Pak Lang, Pak Ngah datang bawa gasing
Aku baru sembilan belas, tali lilit tangan
Semua gelak, "Budak ni, pergi main guli dulu"

[Pre-Chorus]
Tali tarik ketat, kaki buka luas
Kira satu, dua, aku lepaskan

[Chorus - lead rapper, crew shouting 'Pangkah!' back]
Pangkah! Gasing Pak Su melambung keluar
Pangkah! Pak Lang garu kepala
Gasing aku pusing lagi, tak reti berhenti
Pangkah! Siapa lagi nak cuba?

[Verse 2]
Pak Ngah lap gasing kayu merbau dia
"Gasing ni lagi tua dari kau, jaga sikit"
Aku cakap, "Pak Ngah, gasing tua cepat penat"
Satu pangkah, bunyi tok, satu gelanggang terdiam

[Chorus - lead rapper, crew shouting 'Pangkah!' back]
Pangkah! Gasing Pak Ngah tercampak keluar
Pangkah! Pak Ngah buat-buat tak nampak
Gasing aku pusing lagi, tak reti berhenti
Pangkah! Siapa lagi nak cuba?

[Bridge - cowbell and claps only]
MC tengok jam, "Adik, angkat la gasing tu"
Dua puluh minit, gasing aku masih berdengung

[Chorus - lead rapper, crew shouting 'Pangkah!' back]
Pangkah! Tahun depan Pak Su bawa geng
Pangkah! Pak Lang dah mula berlatih
Gasing aku pusing lagi, MC dah balik rumah
Pangkah! Siapa lagi nak cuba?

[Outro - crowd shouts and cowbell]

tracks.title: Lagi! Lagi!
tracks.subject: a young woman who runs the pirate-ship swing at a travelling funfair on a town padang, pushing it higher every time the kids scream 'lagi', and on the last night gives a free ride to the boy in blue slippers who watched every night without a ticket
tracks.caption: Hardstyle dance-pop, a sung pop song on a festival hardstyle beat. A distorted hardstyle kick with a pitched, punchy tail driving every beat; a reverse bass rolling on the off-beats; a wide detuned supersaw lead playing the chorus hook; a bright trance pluck arpeggio under the verses; a filtered breakdown with only the pluck and the voice before the kick returns. Big, loud festival mix, kick and lead forward, supersaws wide, a little fairground crowd noise in the breakdown. Female pop vocal, bright and strong in a mid-high register, singing the verses over the filtered beat and leading a chant-along chorus. 150 BPM, A minor. Euphoric, rowdy and warm-hearted. No trap beat, no dubstep wobble, no idol-pop rap, no autotune, no rap verse, no slow ballad section.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - filtered pluck, kick enters]

[Verse 1]
Padang bandar, minggu ni kami singgah
Lampu kelip, jagung bakar, rumput lecak
Aku pegang lever kapal lanun
Tiket lima ringgit, pegang kuat-kuat

[Pre-Chorus]
Ayun sekali, budak menjerit
Ayun dua kali, mak bapak pun sama

[Chorus]
Lagi! Lagi! Tinggi lagi!
Satu padang jerit tak berhenti
Lagi! Lagi! Sampai bintang
Tolak lever, kita naik lagi

[Verse 2]
Ada budak pakai selipar biru
Tiap malam berdiri tepi pagar
Tak ada tiket, dia cuma tengok
Kira berapa kali kapal naik

[Breakdown - filtered pluck and voice only, fairground crowd noise]
Esok kami angkat khemah ke Taiping
Aku panggil dia, "Dik, naik sini"

[Chorus - kick and supersaw lead return, crowd chanting along]
Lagi! Lagi! Tinggi lagi!
Kapal kosong, cuma dia sorang
Lagi! Lagi! Sampai bintang
Selipar biru tercabut sebelah

[Outro - supersaw lead and crowd]
Esok Taiping, lusa Ipoh
Kalau dengar orang jerit, itu kami

tracks.title: Tak Boleh Bungkus
tracks.subject: a coconut seller on the Teluk Cempedak beach road in Kuantan who refuses to let anyone take a coconut away, making a customer in a hurry sit on his plastic stool and drink it there
tracks.caption: Malay roots reggae with a Nusantara touch. A one-drop drum kit with a cross-stick snare landing on the third beat; a deep, round electric bass playing slow melodic lines; a clean electric guitar chopping the off-beat skank; a melodica answering the vocal with short phrases; a rebana hand drum tapping light fills. Warm and roomy, bass heavy, spring reverb and tape-delay echoes on the melodica and the snare. Male voice, relaxed mid-baritone, conversational and slightly behind the beat, with soft harmony 'ooh's in the chorus. 74 BPM, G major. Unhurried, sunny and dryly funny. No ska horn section, no fast tempo, no autotune, no trap beat, no dancehall synth bass.

tracks.title: Satu Biji Lagi
tracks.subject: a grandmother in Kuala Kangsar who has never lost a game of congkak, and the twenty-eight-year-old grandson who practises on a phone app on the LRT for three months to beat her on a Sunday visit
tracks.caption: Electro-swing pop, light and bouncing, a sung pop song on a swung house beat. A four-on-the-floor house kick with off-beat open hi-hats and a hand clap on two and four; an acoustic piano bouncing swung eighth-note chords and short fills; a brass section of trumpet, trombone and tenor saxophone punching short unison stabs between the lines; a plucked upright bass pumping under a light sidechain; a clean hollow-body electric guitar comping on the off-beats. Clean, punchy modern mix, kick and piano forward, brass tight and close, a short room reverb. Male tenor, warm and smiling, light conversational phrasing, crisp on the swung syllables. 126 BPM, F major. Cheerful, competitive and fond. No vintage mono sound, no walking bass, no brushed drums, no EDM drop, no trap hi-hats, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - piano and a brass stab, house kick enters]

[Verse 1]
Ahad pagi, rumah nenek di Kuala Kangsar
Papan congkak bentuk perahu, kayu cengal
Tujuh lubang sebelah, rumah kat hujung
Nenek senyum, "Nak kalah lagi ke?"

[Pre-Chorus]
Tiga bulan aku berlatih dalam LRT
Lawan app dalam telefon, app pun dah kalah

[Chorus]
Nenek tak pernah kalah
Tangan laju, mata tak berkelip
Aku baru nak kira, dia dah habis kira
Nenek tak pernah kalah, nak main lagi?

[Verse 2]
Biji getah dia simpan dalam tin biskut
Tin Khong Guan, penutupnya dah kemek
Pusingan kedua aku hampir menang
Dia batuk sikit, kiraan aku lari

[Chorus]
Nenek tak pernah kalah
Batuk sikit, tangan dah sampai rumah
Aku baru nak kira, dia dah habis kira
Nenek tak pernah kalah, nak main lagi?

[Bridge - brass and piano trade fills]
Pusingan ketiga, tinggal satu biji
Satu biji je, aku kalah satu biji

[Chorus]
Nenek tak pernah kalah
Tapi hari ni dia tepuk bahu aku
"Satu biji lagi, cu," katanya sambil gelak
Nenek tak pernah kalah, Ahad depan lagi

[Outro - brass stab and piano tag]

tracks.title: 啦啦隊 La-la-tuī
tracks.subject: eleven boys of class 3-8 who lose the draw and must perform a girl-group routine in skirts and wigs at their high school's inter-class cheerleading competition, and the skinniest one at the top of the human pyramid becoming the whole school's idol
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien K-pop-style boy-group dance pop in the bright, bubblegum idol mould. Punchy four-on-the-floor kick with snappy hand claps; a slap bass guitar riff bouncing on the offbeats; glossy brass-synth stabs at the end of each phrase; a bright plucked synth arpeggio under the verses; a hard beat switch with stacked synth chords in the dance break. Tight, polished, loud modern idol mix. A group of young male tenors trading lines, a unison gang chant on the hook, one lead lifting into a clean falsetto on the last chorus. 124 BPM, A major. Cheeky, sweaty and proud. No trap hi-hats, no autotune warble, no EDM drop, no rap verse, no ballad slowdown, no rock guitar.

tracks.title: 龍鬚 Lîng-tshiu
tracks.mood: tender, playful and sure of her
tracks.subject: a couple restoring a temple roof in Tainan in cut-porcelain (jian nian), she on the scaffold snipping red and green bowls into thin strips with her nippers and handing them down, he pressing each one into wet cement to build a dragon's whiskers, passing pieces back and forth all afternoon while the master shouts at them from below
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien Afrobeats love song in the mid-tempo Afro-pop style. A syncopated Afrobeats drum groove with shakers, rim clicks and talking-drum fills; a warm, round bass guitar; two interlocking highlife-style clean electric guitars picking bright patterns; soft Rhodes chords underneath. Warm, airy mix with gentle stereo percussion. A smooth male tenor lead, relaxed and sweet, with a soft female harmony doubling him on the chorus. 104 BPM, B-flat major. Tender, playful and sure of her. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drop, no amapiano log drum, no reggae skank.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
台南的廟頂 下晡日頭赤炎炎
你坐佇鷹架頂 手提鉗仔
紅碗 青碗 剪做細細條
一塊一塊 伸手交予我

[Pre-Chorus]
我共伊 黏入去紅毛塗
龍的喙鬚 一寸一寸生出來

你偷偷仔 剪一塊 粉紅的心

干焦你 佮我知

師傅 佇下跤 咧喝

你佇頂面 我佇下跤

[Outro]
明仔載 你剪 我黏

tracks.mood: fearless, smoke-filled and laughing in the noise
tracks.subject: a first-timer at the Yanshui beehive fireworks on Lantern Festival night, in a full-face helmet, a towel round his neck and three pairs of jeans, standing beside a seventy-year-old regular as the rocket towers are lit
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien 1980s heavy metal in the classic twin-guitar style. Two overdriven electric guitars playing galloping palm-muted riffs and harmonised lead lines in thirds; a pumping eighth-note bass guitar locked to the kick; big live drums with a double-kick run into each chorus; a shredding guitar solo with whammy dives in the bridge. Loud, roomy 1980s arena-metal production with gated reverb on the snare. A powerful high male tenor, clean and belting, holding a high note at the end of the last chorus, with a gang-shout backing on the hook. 168 BPM, E minor. Fearless, smoke-filled and laughing in the noise. No metalcore breakdowns, no growled vocals, no blast beats, no Chinese opera instruments, no pop chorus, no autotune.

tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien bluegrass in the fast traditional string-band style. A three-finger rolling five-string banjo; a fiddle playing double-stop fills and a short breakdown; a mandolin chopping the offbeat; a flat-picked acoustic guitar with bass-note runs between chords; an upright bass thumping root-fifth on one and three. tracks.title: ทุเรียนเต้นได้ (Dancing Durian)
tracks.mood: sweaty, giddy and proud of it
tracks.subject: a woman inside a giant durian mascot suit dancing the shows every two hours at a shopping mall's durian fair, seeing the crowd only through the mesh mouth
tracks.caption: Thai disco-pop in the glossy mid-2020s nu-disco lane of the 2025 'Born Again' chart hit, sung in Thai. A four-on-the-floor kick with an open hi-hat on every off-beat; an octave-jumping disco bass guitar; a muted chicken-scratch rhythm guitar playing sixteenths; a string section with rising sweeps into each chorus; a bright analog synth arpeggio. Polished and wide, punchy kick, glossy strings, light plate reverb on the voice. Female mezzo-soprano, bright and playful, breathy in the verses, full chest voice in the chorus. 118 BPM, F minor. Sweaty, giddy and proud of it. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drop, no rap verse, no slap bass.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - string sweep, disco bass and rhythm guitar]

[Verse 1]
งานทุเรียนกลางห้าง บ่ายสองโมงตรง
พี่สต๊าฟรูดซิปให้ ฉันกลายเป็นทุเรียนยักษ์
มองโลกผ่านตาข่ายตรงปาก
เด็กดึงหนามฉันเล่น แม่เด็กยกมือถือถ่าย

[Pre-Chorus]
พิธีกรนับหนึ่ง สอง สาม
เพลงดิสโก้ดังขึ้น ฉันต้องออกไปแล้ว

[Chorus]
ทุเรียนเต้นได้ ดูสิ ทุเรียนเต้นได้
เหงื่อไหลเป็นทางกลางหลัง แต่ยังหมุนไม่หยุด
หนามสั่นทุกทีที่ฉันส่ายสะโพก
วันละหกร้อย ฉันเต้นให้คุ้มทุกบาท

[Verse 2]
สี่โมงรอบสอง เด็กผู้ชายตะโกนว่าเหม็น
ฉันโค้งให้หนึ่งที แล้วส่ายก้นใส่เบาๆ
ป้าเจ้าของสวนจากจันท์ ยื่นน้ำเย็นมาพร้อมหลอด
ฉันดูดผ่านตาข่าย เหมือนกินน้ำลอดมุ้ง

[Pre-Chorus]
ไฟลานเปลี่ยนเป็นสีทอง
ลำโพงกระหึ่มอีกรอบ ฉันต้องออกไปแล้ว

[Chorus]
ทุเรียนเต้นได้ ดูสิ ทุเรียนเต้นได้
คนชั้นสองหยุดเดิน ชะโงกลงมาดูเป็นแถว
หนามสั่นทุกทีที่ฉันส่ายสะโพก
วันละหกร้อย แต่รอบนี้ฉันเต้นเกินค่าแรง

[Outro - strings and disco bass fade]
หกโมงรอบสุดท้าย ถอดหัวออกมาหายใจ
เด็กที่ว่าเหม็นยืนมอง แล้วขอถ่ายรูปกับฉันหนึ่งที

tracks.title: เสือขยิบตา (The Tiger Winked)
tracks.subject: a Mathayom 4 boy in the school sports-day card-stunt stand who flips to the wrong page and puts a white dot in the giant tiger's eye in front of the whole school
tracks.caption: Thai hardstyle dance-pop, a festival-hardstyle school-cheer anthem in the 2025 'Jump' chart lane, sung in Thai. A distorted hardstyle kick with a long pitched tail on every beat and an off-beat reverse bass; a screeching detuned supersaw lead playing a short chant riff; marching-band snare rolls building into each drop; school brass trumpet stabs doubling the lead. Loud, compressed festival mix, wide lead, vocal kept clear on top. Young male tenor, breathless and comic, verses sung in half-time over the kick; on each chorus a shouted group chant of schoolkids on the first line, then the tenor alone. 150 BPM, A minor. Frantic, red-faced and triumphant. No trap, no autotune, no dubstep wobble, no rap verse, no slow piano breakdown.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - hardstyle kick, marching snare roll and trumpet stab]

[Verse 1]
กีฬาสีวันสุดท้าย แดดเที่ยงเผาต้นคอ
ผมนั่งแถวสิบสี่ ที่เก้า บนสแตนด์สีแดง
โพยแปะไว้บนเข่า ภาพละหนึ่งบรรทัด
พี่มอหกเป่านกหวีด ทั้งสแตนด์ชูป้ายพร้อมกัน

[Pre-Chorus]
ภาพที่สิบเจ็ด เสือยักษ์ทั้งตัว
ผมพลิกผิดหน้า ชูสีขาวออกไปเต็มแขน

[Chorus - schoolkids shout the first line, lead vocal after]
แปร แปร แปรอักษร
เสือแดงทั้งสแตนด์ คำรามใส่สนาม
แต่ตาซ้ายมีจุดขาว ตรงที่ผมนั่ง
เสือตัวนี้ขยิบตา ทั้งโรงเรียนเห็นหมด

[Verse 2]
พี่มอหกหันมามอง หน้าแดงกว่าเสื้อสี
ครูพละยกโทรโข่ง ชี้มาที่แถวสิบสี่
เพื่อนข้างๆ กลั้นขำจนป้ายสั่นไปทั้งแถว
จะพลิกกลับก็ไม่ทัน โดรนบินผ่านหัวพอดี

[Pre-Chorus]
กรรมการใต้เต็นท์ จดอะไรสักอย่าง
แล้วลุกขึ้นปรบมือ ให้เสือของเรา

[Chorus - schoolkids shout the first line, lead vocal after]
แปร แปร แปรอักษร
เสือแดงขยิบตา กรรมการขำจนตัวงอ
จุดขาวจุดเดียว ตรงที่ผมนั่ง
ได้รางวัลขวัญใจกรรมการ เพราะป้ายขาวของผม

[Outro - snare roll and kick, then cut]
แถวสิบสี่ ที่เก้า
ปีหน้าพี่เขาให้ผมถือป้ายขาวทั้งวัน

tracks.subject: a parcel courier on a Pak Kret housing-estate route who knows every dog on it by name, and the old brown dog that guards a parcel for him when nobody is home
tracks.caption: Thai jazz-rap over boom-bap drums, in the jazz-phrased Bangkok hip-hop lane of 2025's Hip-Hop Artist of the Year, Rejizz. Dusty swung boom-bap drums with a fat kick and a cracked snare on two and four; an upright bass walking a slow minor line; a muted trumpet answering the ends of the rap lines; a Rhodes electric piano playing minor ninth chords. Live and close, dry drums, the voice up front, light tape saturation. Male baritone rapper with a relaxed conversational flow, unhurried and wry, the chorus half-sung softly. 88 BPM, D minor. Warm, wry and footsore. No trap hi-hats, no 808 slides, no autotune, no lo-fi vinyl crackle or tape wobble, no EDM synths, no luk thung hook.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - muted trumpet, Rhodes and upright bass]

[Verse 1]
เก้าโมงเช้า ท้ายรถมีเจ็ดสิบสองกล่อง
หมู่บ้านเดิมแถวปากเกร็ด ผมวนจนคล่อง
บ้านสิบสอง เจ้าดำเห่าเสียงดังลั่นรั้ว
แต่หางมันส่ายไม่หยุด เห่าไปงั้นแหละ ไม่ต้องกลัว
บ้านสิบเก้า ปอมขาวเกลียดหมวกกันน็อกของผม

[Chorus]
ซอยนี้หมาจำผมได้ ก่อนเจ้าของเปิดประตู

ใครไม่อยู่ เซ็นรับไม่ได้ก็ไม่เป็นไร
ให้มันดมมือผมทีนึง ก็นับว่ารับแล้ว

[Verse 2]
บ่ายสองแดดเปรี้ยง กล่องใหญ่เป็นหม้อทอดไร้น้ำมัน
โทรสามรอบ เจ้าของไม่รับ เงียบไปทั้งวัน
ลุงทองหมาแก่สีน้ำตาล เดินตามผมมาจนสุดซอย
นอนเฝ้ากล่องหน้าบ้านให้ ผมถ่ายรูปยืนยันแล้วค่อยถอย
ตกเย็นลูกค้าให้ห้าดาว ชมว่าของถึงไว
เขาไม่รู้ว่าใครนอนเฝ้า แต่ผมรู้ว่าใคร

[Chorus]
ซอยนี้หมาจำผมได้ ก่อนเจ้าของเปิดประตู
ในกระเป๋าเสื้อผม ขนมหมามากกว่าเหรียญทอน
ห้าดาวที่ได้มาวันนี้
แบ่งให้ลุงทองสี่ดวง ผมขอเก็บไว้ดวงเดียว

[Outro - trumpet and Rhodes fade]
พรุ่งนี้เก้าโมง ผมวนมาใหม่
เจ้าตูบ เอาถุงมือคืนมาได้แล้ว

tracks.title: สองแปดเจ็ด (Two-Eight-Seven)
tracks.subject: a father who vowed a kae-bon likay show to the village shrine if his son passed the police-cadet exam, sitting in the front row in a pressed white shirt while the likay prince weaves the son's name and his score of 287 into the plot
tracks.caption: Thai likay folk-theatre song in the temple-fair stage tradition, sung in Thai and opening with the ranikloeng cry. A likay piphat band: a ranat ek xylophone playing fast ornamented runs; a khong wong yai gong circle doubling the melody; a reedy pi nai oboe answering each sung line; a taphon barrel drum and a pair of klong that drums driving the stage rhythm; ching cymbals ticking the cycle. Live open-air stage sound through a boomy temple-fair PA, close vocal with a short slapback. Male tenor in likay style, nasal and bright, long sliding melismas on held vowels, crisp comic diction on the quick lines. 108 BPM, G major. Comic, puffed-up and proud. No drum kit, no electric guitar, no synths, no luk thung brass, no pop ballad chorus.

metas.prompt: Thai likay folk-theatre song in the temple-fair stage tradition, sung in Thai and opening with the ranikloeng cry. A likay piphat band: a ranat ek xylophone playing fast ornamented runs; a khong wong yai gong circle doubling the melody; a reedy pi nai oboe answering each sung line; a taphon barrel drum and a pair of klong that drums driving the stage rhythm; ching cymbals ticking the cycle. Live open-air stage sound through a boomy temple-fair PA, close vocal with a short slapback. Male tenor in likay style, nasal and bright, long sliding melismas on held vowels, crisp comic diction on the quick lines. 108 BPM, G major. Comic, puffed-up and proud. No drum kit, no electric guitar, no synths, no luk thung brass, no pop ballad chorus.

tracks.title: ฉาบคู่นี้ (These Cymbals)
tracks.subject: the cymbal player in a hired long-drum troupe who has played behind the same woman dancing at the head of every merit procession for six years, and this kathin hands his cymbals to the new boy and walks up front to dance beside her
tracks.caption: Thai klong yao long-drum procession song in the applied village style, on the classic toet-toeng groove, sung in Thai. Four klong yao long drums slapped by hand in a rolling interlocking pattern; large and small chap cymbals crashing on the off-beats; a hanging khong gong marking every cycle; a pi chawa oboe looping a bright folk tune; ching cymbals ticking. Open-air outdoor sound, drums up front, troupe shouts and claps behind the singer. Male baritone, warm and plain-spoken, a little shy, village folk delivery with short held notes. 128 BPM, D major. Bright, shy and quietly brave. No drum kit, no electric bass, no synths, no brass band, no luk thung string section.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - klong yao drums, chap cymbals and pi chawa]

[Verse 1]
ทอดกฐินปีนี้ วัดอยู่อีกฝั่งทุ่ง
ขบวนออกเจ็ดโมงเช้า ถนนลูกรังฝุ่นคลุ้ง
ผมตีฉาบอยู่แถวสาม ตามหลังกลองยาวสี่ใบ
ส่วนเธอรำนำหน้าขบวน เหมือนทุกงานที่ผ่านมา

[Pre-Chorus]
หกปีที่ผมตีฉาบ หกปีที่เธอรำ
เราไม่เคยคุยกันเกินสามคำ

[Chorus]
ฉาบคู่นี้ตีให้เธอมาหกปี
เธอยกมือขึ้นเมื่อไร ผมก็ตีรับทุกที
เธอเหนื่อยเมื่อไร ผมผ่อนจังหวะให้ช้า
แค่เธอไม่เคยหันมาดูว่าใครตี

[Verse 2]
ถึงลานวัดเที่ยงตรง พื้นปูนร้อนเหมือนกระทะ
เธอรำเท้าเปล่า ยิ้มทั้งที่เหงื่อซึม
ผมยื่นฉาบให้ไอ้ต้น เด็กใหม่ในวงตีแทน
แล้วเดินออกไปหน้าขบวน รำผิดจังหวะไปทั้งเพลง

[Pre-Chorus]
หกปีที่ผมตีฉาบ วันนี้ผมขอรำ
เธอหัวเราะแล้วพูดมาสามคำ มาสักที

[Chorus]
ฉาบคู่นั้นตีให้เธอมาหกปี
วันนี้มือผมว่าง เลยได้รำข้างคนดี
เธอเหนื่อยเมื่อไร ผมจะพาเดินช้าๆ
จนถึงหน้าโบสถ์ เธอก็ยังรำอยู่ข้างผม

[Outro - drums and pi chawa, troupe shouts]
ไอ้ต้นตีฉาบเพี้ยนไปสามรอบโบสถ์
ไม่มีใครบ่นสักคน ทุกคนมัวแต่ดูเรา

ไอ้ต้นตีฉาบเพี้ยนไปสามรอบโบสถ์

tracks.title: Hổng Nở Tui Đền
tracks.subject: a young Saigon gardener going house to house in Phú Nhuận on the fifteenth of the twelfth lunar month to strip the leaves off customers' potted yellow mai trees, promising each tree will open on Tết morning or he pays them back, while a café owner on Hoa Sứ street wants his open two days early and the neighbour's boy phones every morning to report cracked buds
tracks.caption: Afrobeats-influenced V-pop, mid-tempo Afro-pop with a highlife guitar lilt, a West African Afrobeats groove under a Southern Vietnamese pop melody. A clean electric guitar picking bright highlife-style arpeggios; a shekere locking the swung sixteenths; a talking drum adding short pitch-bending fills at the ends of phrases; a warm round sub-bass; soft Rhodes chords on the off-beats over a syncopated Afrobeats kick, rimshot and clap pattern. Warm, sunny and spacious, percussion crisp and forward, dry intimate lead vocal. Male voice, a relaxed light tenor singing close and conversational in Southern Vietnamese, with a soft female harmony doubling the chorus lines. 106 BPM, G major. Playful, cocky and easygoing. No amapiano log drum, no reggaeton dembow, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drop, no rap verse.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - short, highlife guitar, shekere and talking drum]

[Verse 1]
Rằm tháng Chạp, tui xách cây kéo đi một vòng
Hẻm nào có chậu mai là nghe kêu: Út ơi!
Cô Tư Phú Nhuận ra đứng chờ trước cổng
Hỏi y chang năm ngoái: kịp Tết hông con?

[Pre-Chorus]
Lặt sạch cả cây, chừa lại từng cái cuống
Nụ nhỏ như hột tiêu, tui đếm được ba trăm

[Chorus - Male lead, female harmony]
Mùng Một nó nở, vàng rực cả hiên
Hổng nở đúng ngày thì Út đây đền
Sáng tưới một gáo, trưa cho ăn nắng
Cây nó biết Tết, cô ngủ cho yên

[Verse 2]
Ông chủ quán cà phê bên đường Hoa Sứ
Đòi mai nở hăm tám cho khách chụp hình
Thằng nhỏ nhà bên sáng nào cũng gọi
Anh Út ơi, nụ nứt vỏ rồi nè anh!

[Pre-Chorus]
Trễ thì tưới nước ấm, sớm thì đem vô chỗ mát
Tui dỗ từng cây như dỗ con nít trong nhà

[Chorus - Male lead, female harmony]
Mùng Một nó nở, vàng rực cả hiên
Hổng nở đúng ngày thì Út đây đền
Quán thì hăm tám, cô Tư mùng Một
Cây nào hẹn nấy, tui ghi sổ liền

[Bridge - half-time, guitar and talking drum]
Nói nhỏ nghe, mười năm tui đền có một cây
Năm đó trời trở lạnh, mai cả Sài Gòn trễ chung

[Outro - highlife guitar and shekere fading]
Mùng Một nó nở, hổng nở tui đền nghe cô

tracks.title: Chày Anh, Chày Em
tracks.genre: Khmer Nam Bộ rom vong folk-pop
tracks.subject: two young Khmer sweethearts in Trà Vinh sharing one wooden mortar to pound cốm dẹp on the full-moon night of Ok Om Bok, his pestle coming down each time hers goes up, so neither can look away without the pestles clashing
tracks.caption: Khmer Nam Bộ folk-pop, a Vietnamese pop love song built on the swaying rom vong circle-dance rhythm of the Mekong Delta's Khmer communities. A chapei long-neck lute plucking short twangy riffs; a roneat ek xylophone rippling runs between the lines; skor hand drums and chhing finger cymbals keeping the rom vong pulse; a tro fiddle doubling the chorus melody; a soft round electric bass and light brushed pop drums underneath. Warm and open, acoustic instruments forward and natural, gentle room reverb, modern low end kept subtle. Duet: a warm young female mezzo with light Khmer-style ornaments and a soft male tenor trading verses and pre-choruses, both together in the chorus. 100 BPM, D major. Tender, moonlit and quietly joyful. No EDM drop, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no rap, no Thai luk thung twang.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - chapei riff, skor drums and chhing]

[Verse 1 - Female]
Rằm tháng Mười, trăng treo trên ngọn cây dầu
Nếp non rang lách tách, mùi thơm nồng
Má biểu em ra cái cối sau chùa
Một cây chày, giã tới chừng nào cho xong

[Pre-Chorus - Male]
Anh bước qua, nhấc thêm cây chày thứ hai
Hỏi nhỏ: em lên, anh xuống, được hông?

[Chorus - Duet]
Chày em lên thì chày anh xuống
Thình thịch đều, trăng cũng gật gù theo
Lệch một nhịp là hai chày đụng nhau
Nên hai đứa mình cứ phải nhìn nhau hoài

[Verse 2 - Male]
Hồi nãy ông già trong sóc đút cốm cho tụi nhỏ
Hỏi từng đứa năm nay muốn ước gì
Anh chen vô hàng, ông cười, hổng thèm hỏi
Ông nói: điều con ước đang giã bên kia kìa

[Pre-Chorus - Female]
Anh kể tới đó, mặt em nóng như nồi cốm
Chày em hụt một nhịp, suýt đụng chày anh

[Chorus - Duet]
Chày em lên thì chày anh xuống
Thình thịch đều, trăng cũng gật gù theo
Lỡ lệch một nhịp, anh đứng chờ em
Mình cứ nhìn nhau giã tới sáng thì thôi

[Bridge - Female, skor drums and chhing only]
Mai ra Ao Bà Om thả đèn xuống nước
Em gói phần anh một nắm cốm trong lá chuối

[Outro - Duet, chapei and skor drums fading]
Chày lên, chày xuống, rằm này rằm sau

tracks.title: Tờ Vé Trong Vành Nón
tracks.subject: a lottery-ticket seller in her sixties who walks the same twelve cafés on Phan Xích Long every afternoon, knows each regular's lucky number, and keeps one ticket a day in her hat brim that she never checks
tracks.caption: Vietnamese modern rumba ballad, a lyrical nhạc trữ tình melody set on a polished modern rumba groove, as in the 2025 viral hit 'Say một đời vì em'. A nylon-string Spanish guitar strumming a steady rumba pattern with short rasgueado flourishes; congas and bongos carrying the tumbao; a warm, melodic electric bass walking root and fifth; soft electric piano chords; a light string section lifting under the chorus. Clean, warm and close, guitar centred, percussion crisp, polished but uncluttered. Female voice, a warm low alto with a slight vibrato, unhurried storytelling phrasing in Southern Vietnamese, a little smile in the delivery. 96 BPM, E minor. Wry, warm and unhurried. No bolero rhythm, no EDM drop, no trap drums, no autotune, no rap, no Vinahouse bass.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - nylon guitar rumba strum and congas]

[Verse 1]
Hai giờ trưa, cô kẹp xấp vé đi một vòng
Mười hai quán cà phê, đâu cũng gọi "cô Sáu ơi"
Anh Tư bàn góc chỉ mua đuôi ba chín
Ba năm chưa trúng mà lần nào cũng cười

[Pre-Chorus]
Bốn giờ mười lăm, đài bắt đầu quay số
Cả con đường dò vé, trừ mình cô

[Chorus]
Cô để dành một tờ, nhét trong vành nón
Không dò, không coi, cũng chẳng hỏi ai
Trúng thì để mai, trật thì để mai
Chưa dò thì chiều nay cô vẫn còn giàu

[Verse 2]
Có bữa trời mưa, cô núp dưới mái hiên
Cậu sinh viên tóc xù chạy ra mua năm tờ
Nói "cô về sớm đi, trời mưa lớn quá"
Cô lén kẹp thêm một tờ, nó đâu có ngờ

[Pre-Chorus]
Bốn giờ mười lăm, anh Tư lại trật
Ảnh cười, mua thêm tờ đuôi ba chín cho mai

[Chorus]
Cô để dành một tờ, nhét trong vành nón
Không dò, không coi, cũng chẳng hỏi ai
Trúng thì để mai, trật thì để mai
Có tờ trong nón, cô ngủ ngon như người giàu

[Bridge - guitar and strings, congas drop out]
Người ta hỏi nếu trúng thì cô làm gì
Cô cười: chắc cô vẫn đi mười hai quán mỗi chiều

[Outro - nylon guitar and congas, slowing]
Vé số đây, ai mua giùm cô một tờ

tracks.title: Đi Bão Tới Sáng
tracks.subject: riding đi bão round Hoàn Kiếm Lake all night on the back of a friend's motorbike after Vietnam wins a football final in the ninety-fourth minute, banging a pot lid taken from the bia hơi stall, and croaking through the next morning's meeting to find the boss has lost his voice too
tracks.caption: Vietnamese hard rock in the Bức Tường lineage, 1990s Hà Nội hard rock with power-metal twin-guitar harmonies. Two overdriven electric guitars, one chugging palm-muted eighth-note riffs, the other playing harmonised twin leads between the lines; a driving pick-played electric bass locked to the kick; hard-hitting live drums with open hi-hats, tom fills and a crash on every chorus downbeat; a full-throated gang-shout crowd chorus. Raw, loud live-band sound, big drum room, guitars wide left and right, vocal on top with a short slap delay. Male voice, a gritty high rock tenor belting with a rasp, hoarse on the long notes, a crowd of male voices shouting the hooks. 148 BPM, E minor. Rowdy, joyful and hoarse. No pop-punk, no metalcore screams, no synths, no autotune, no EDM, no ballad section.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - twin-guitar riff and drum count-in]

[Verse 1]
Phút chín mươi tư, bóng lăn qua vạch
Cả quán bia hơi nhảy cẫng lên, đổ cả ghế
Tao vớ luôn cái vung nồi của quán
Thằng Tùng hét "lên xe!", cờ quấn vai, mũ cài quai

[Pre-Chorus]
Ra tới Tràng Tiền, xe chật cứng như nêm
Mà chẳng ai cáu, người lạ cũng ôm nhau

[Chorus - gang vocals]
Đi bão! Đi bão! Gõ vung cho thủng
Cả Hà Nội đêm nay chẳng ai ngủ
Hò cho khản cổ, hét cho rát họng
Việt Nam vô địch, mai tính sau!

[Verse 2]
Hai giờ sáng, mua ngô nướng ven hồ
Bà bán ngô không lấy tiền: "Hôm nay vui!"
Thằng Tùng chở tao vòng hồ lần thứ bảy
Đèn đỏ vẫn dừng, mà mồm vẫn hát không thôi

[Pre-Chorus]
Chú công an đứng chốt cũng giơ tay vẫy
Cười bảo: "Về đi các cháu, mai còn đi làm"

[Chorus - gang vocals]
Đi bão! Đi bão! Gõ vung cho thủng
Cả Hà Nội đêm nay chẳng ai ngủ
Hò cho khản cổ, hét cho rát họng
Mai đi làm hả? Mai tính sau!

[Bridge - half-time, ringing guitars]
Tám giờ sáng họp, sếp gọi tên tao
Tao mở mồm ra, chỉ còn tiếng thều thào
Sếp cũng khàn đặc: "Tối qua anh cũng đi!"

[Outro - full band, gang shout, abrupt stop]
Đi bão! Việt Nam vô địch!

tracks.title: Vịt Đi Trước, Xe Đi Sau
tracks.subject: a Quảng Nam duck herder walking two thousand ducks south along the shoulder of Highway 1A at dusk, from the harvested Duy Xuyên fields to Thăng Bình, a flag tied to his bamboo pole, holding up a tour bus and arguing with a Grab rider taking a passenger to Chu Lai airport, who ends up crawling behind with his headlight on the ducks
tracks.caption: Bài chòi folk-pop from the central coast of Quảng Nam and Bình Định, the call-and-answer folk-game singing set over a light modern folk-pop band. A đàn cò two-string fiddle sliding between the singer's lines; a bài chòi barrel drum and a wooden clapper keeping a bouncing beat; a mõ woodblock clicking the off-beats; a kèn bầu shawm blowing short calls into each chorus; an acoustic bass and a soft kick drum underneath. Bright, open and outdoor, folk instruments up front and dry, light reverb on the calls. Male voice, a loud cheerful baritone in a central-coast accent, singing bài chòi call-style with long 'ơ' call-outs and quick spoken asides, a man and a woman shouting short replies in the chorus. 116 BPM, G major. Rowdy, cheeky and stubborn. No EDM drop, no trap drums, no autotune, no rap, no cải lương vọng cổ, no Western pop guitar.

tracks.title: 推車恰恰
tracks.mood: cheeky, bustling and quick on her feet
tracks.subject: a dim sum trolley auntie at one of Hong Kong's last old-style trolley teahouses who knows every regular's order by the sound of their walk, pushing her squeaking trolley through the Sunday morning rush
tracks.caption: Cantonese cha-cha-cha in the style of 1960s Hong Kong Cantonese film songs, charanga line-up. A scraped guiro on every beat and the 'cha-cha-chá' on four-and-one, timbales with cowbell, a bright upright piano playing a montuno pattern, a wooden charanga flute trilling over two violins playing short unison riffs, upright bass playing a tumbao. Warm live-room recording with slight tape hiss and room reverb, the whole band audible as one take. A brassy female alto, chatty and teasing, half-calling her lines like a teahouse vendor, the band answering 'cha cha cha' in unison. 120 BPM, Bb major. Cheeky, bustling Sunday-morning rush. No electric organ, no saxophone, no drum kit, no reggaeton beat, no EDM drums, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
朝早六點 茶樓開門
我架車 轆仔吱吱聲
蝦餃燒賣 疊到高過我個頭
蒸氣一噴 我就開工

[Pre-Chorus]
六號枱阿伯 未坐低我都知
拖鞋聲一響 梗係鳳爪排骨

[Chorus]
推車 cha cha cha
叉燒包 熱辣辣
轉個彎 cha cha cha
唔使招手 我嚟緊喇

[Verse]
十點鐘 人逼到出門口
報紙霸位 茶壺揭開蓋
後生仔 揚住張點心紙
我幫你蓋印 你自己揀

[Pre-Chorus]
蒸籠一揭 成堆人企起身
我條腰 扭到好似跳舞咁

[Chorus]
推車 cha cha cha
馬拉糕 熱辣辣
轉個彎 cha cha cha
你哋爭 我照笑住派

[Bridge]
三十年 行同一條通道
左腳右腳 車轆都跟住拍

[Chorus]
推車 cha cha cha
最後一籠 熱辣辣
執埋枱 cha cha cha
聽朝六點 我再嚟過

[Outro]
叉燒包 叉燒包 邊位要

tracks.title: 清醒一鏢
tracks.subject: a Wan Chai pub darts team of six minibus drivers who need double-top with the last dart to win the Kowloon league final, and their thrower, who has never hit it sober, stuck on lemon tea because he drives the 5 a.m. first run
tracks.caption: Cantonese Britpop in the mid-90s guitar-band mould. Two electric guitars, one a jangly 12-string strum and one a crunchy overdriven rhythm wall, a Hammond organ swelling under the chorus, a melodic bass line moving against the chords, straight pounding drums with tambourine on every off-beat. Big, slightly compressed band-in-a-room sound, guitars panned wide, unpolished. A nasal male tenor with a lazy, swaggering drawl in the verses, opening into a full-throated terrace singalong on the chorus with friends joining in unison. 126 BPM, E major. Rowdy, laddish, silly and triumphant. No pop-punk, no emo, no autotune, no synth-pop, no EDM build.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
星期六晚 灣仔老酒吧
九龍聯賽 決賽打到最尾
六個揸小巴嘅 着住同款隊衫
剩低四十分 一枝鏢 輪到阿華

[Pre-Chorus]
佢話冇三支啤酒落肚 從來都未中過
聽朝五點揸頭班車 今晚淨係飲檸檬茶

[Chorus]
雙倍二十 喺最頂
阿華 你得㗎喇
大埔道十八彎 你眼都唔眨
一枝鏢 驚乜嘢

[Verse]
對面觀塘的士隊 笑到拍枱
老闆偷偷推杯啤酒埋嚟
佢推返轉頭 話聽朝要開工
成間酒吧 靜到聽到雪櫃響

[Pre-Chorus]
佢好似埋站咁 望一望倒後鏡
吸一啖氣 等個綠燈

[Chorus]
雙倍二十 喺最頂
阿華 全場望住你
大埔道十八彎 你眼都唔眨
清醒一鏢 驚乜嘢

[Bridge]
枝鏢飛出去 慢過紅隧塞車
啪一聲 釘正最頂嗰條窄邊
六個大男人 攬住跌落地

[Chorus]
中咗喇 雙倍二十
阿華 你自己都唔信
一滴酒都冇 照樣中
九龍個盃 喺灣仔捧

[Outro]
聽朝五點 佢揸頭班車 一路唱
Double Top 喂 Double Top

tracks.title: 一部計數機
tracks.subject: two adults in their thirties retaking the DSE at a Mong Kok evening school who share her calculator all term because his battery is dead, though she has seen the unopened pack of new batteries in his bag, and who open their results envelopes together on the school steps
tracks.caption: Cantonese country-pop with a Nashville front-porch feel. A strummed steel-string acoustic guitar, a pedal steel sliding under every line, a fiddle answering the vocal in the gaps, a light five-string banjo roll in the chorus, round electric bass, a brushed snare with a soft kick. Clean, warm, sunlit studio mix, instruments close and dry with a little room air. A warm female mid-range lead, plain and conversational, a light crack on the long notes, a soft male harmony joining on the last chorus. 100 BPM, A major. Shy, sunny and hopeful. No trap beat, no autotune, no EDM drop, no rap section, no Cantopop piano ballad, no stadium rock guitars.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
旺角夜校 逢星期二四
三十幾歲人 返嚟再考文憑試
隔籬個男人 部計數機開極都開唔着
佢話冇電 塊面紅到耳仔

[Pre-Chorus]
我將我部 推去兩張枱中間
你一題 我一題 輪住㩒

[Chorus]
一部計數機 兩個人
你㩒完 推返過嚟我呢邊
啲掣仲暖 你啱啱㩒過
成晚 我條數都計唔啱

[Verse]
開學冇幾耐 佢個書包跌落地
跌咗排新電芯出嚟 未拆過
佢執返入去 扮冇事
照樣問我 部計數機借唔借

[Pre-Chorus]
我冇出聲 照樣推過去
兩個人 擰轉面偷笑

[Chorus]
一部計數機 兩個人
你㩒完 推返過嚟我呢邊
你書包嗰排電芯 我唔講
等你 一直借到最後一堂

[Bridge]
七月放榜嗰朝 學校門口
揸住信封 坐喺石級上面
佢話 數到三 一齊拆

[Chorus]
兩個信封 兩個人
你合格 我都合格
部計數機 你終於還返畀我
你話 下次想借我隻手

[Outro]
借畀你 唔使還

tracks.title: 粉紅馬頭圍道
tracks.subject: a To Kwa Wan neon-sign maker hand-bending glass tubes over a gas flame through the night to finish a four-metre sign for Bing Kee, a noodle shop reopening that evening, down to the twenty-stroke character for noodles, until he flips the switch and Ma Tau Wai Road turns pink
tracks.caption: Cantonese uplifting trance-pop in the classic late-2000s vocal-trance mould. A four-on-the-floor kick with open hi-hats on the off-beats, a rolling off-beat bassline, a bright supersaw lead playing fast 16th-note arpeggios, gated trance pads pulsing under the verses, a long snare-roll build into each chorus and a short breakdown with a plucked piano arp. Wide, airy trance mix with long hall reverb on the supersaw lead and gentle sidechain breathing on the pads. A clear male tenor, breathless and quick in the verses, opening up full-voiced and sustained on the chorus. 138 BPM, G minor. Sleepless, stubborn and euphoric. No hardstyle kick, no big-room drop, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no rap verse, no slow ballad section.

凌晨一點 土瓜灣工場

tracks.title: 換香
tracks.subject: a Tai Hang local who runs beside the 67-metre fire dragon on Mid-Autumn night with a bag of joss sticks, pulling out the burnt-down ones and pushing in fresh ones through the smoke
tracks.caption: Cantonese stoner rock with a slow desert-rock groove. Down-tuned fuzz guitar riffs through a cranked valve amp, a thick distorted bass doubling the riff, slow pounding drums with big floor toms, and a Chinese lion-dance drum, gong and hand cymbals hitting with the riff in the processional sections. Smoky, saturated live-room recording, amps humming between riffs, percussion mixed up front. A low gravelly male baritone, unhurried and chant-like, a crew shouting the answer lines. 76 BPM, D minor. Heavy, smoky, proud and hypnotic. No metal growls, no blast beats, no autotune, no pop-ballad chorus, no EDM.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
中秋夜 浣紗街
六十七米 一條草龍
七萬枝香 插滿佢成身
煙大到 隔籬嘅人都睇唔清

[Pre-Chorus]
鑼鼓一響 龍頭抬起
我揹住一袋香 跟住佢條尾

[Chorus]
換香 換香
燒剩半截 拔走插返枝新
眼濕濕 係煙焗 唔係喊
換香 換香 唔好畀條龍熄

[Verse]
細路騎喺老竇膊頭
遊客舉高部電話
條龍轉個身 掃過我頭頂
啲香灰 跌落我件白背心

[Pre-Chorus]
一百幾年前 呢度有瘟疫
老人家話 就係咁舞 先舞走佢

[Chorus]
換香 換香
條龍轉得幾快 我都照插
眼濕濕 係煙焗 唔係喊
換香 換香 唔好畀條龍熄

[Bridge]
第三晚 我哋送佢落海
拍走成身香灰 等明年

[Chorus]
換香 換香
大坑成條街 成晚都係香
眼濕濕 係煙焗 唔係喊
換香 換香 明年中秋再嚟

[Outro]
龍走咗 我件背心仲有陣香

tracks.title: 天黑請閉眼
tracks.subject: a Friday werewolf-game night at a board-game café where she peeks during the night phase, sees the boy she likes is the werewolf, and keeps voting the wrong way to save him
tracks.caption: Mandarin UK garage in the late-1990s two-step style. A shuffling two-step drum machine with skipped kicks and crisp swung hi-hats; a rubbery sub bass sliding between notes; warm organ stabs playing minor seventh chords; soft electric piano filling the gaps; a filtered string pad under the chorus. Clean late-night club mix, dry close vocal, light sidechain pump. Female voice, a light airy mezzo, conversational and teasing in the verses, stacked harmonies on the chorus. 132 BPM, F minor. Flirty, hushed and lit up. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no big-room EDM drop, no drum and bass breakbeats, no sampled voice snippets.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - two-step drums and organ chords]

[Verse 1]
禮拜五晚上 桌遊店最裡面那一桌
法官發完牌 說不可以偷看
你把牌蓋好 喝一口奶茶
說你是平民 眼睛都不眨

[Pre-Chorus]
大家都在推理 我只顧著看
你的吸管 又轉了三圈

[Chorus]
天黑請閉眼 我偷偷瞄一眼
看到你舉手 指著我的好朋友
天亮了 你說你好怕
我就跟著你 一起投錯人

[Verse 2]

tracks.caption: Mandarin pop-punk in the early-2000s sing-along style. tracks.title: 烤肉醬借一下
tracks.subject: Mid-Autumn night in a lane where every family barbecues on the pavement, and a son sent from grill to grill to get his mother's borrowed bottle of barbecue sauce back
tracks.caption: Mandarin new jack swing in the late-1980s Teddy Riley style. A swung drum machine beat with a hard gated snare and shuffled sixteenth hi-hats; punchy synth-brass stabs on the off-beats; a slap-style synth bass line; a bright digital electric piano playing stacked chords; finger snaps and hand claps on the backbeat. Crisp bright late-1980s mix, dry drums up front, wide synths. Male tenor, smooth and playful with short melismatic runs, trading call-and-response lines with a group of backing singers on the chorus. 106 BPM, G minor. Rowdy, neighbourly and teasing. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no live horn section, no EDM drop, no modern rap verse.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - synth-brass stabs and swung drum machine]

[Verse 1]
中秋節晚上 整條巷子都在冒煙
阿伯穿著汗衫 拿扇子猛搧炭
三樓阿姨的玉米 已經烤到第二輪
我媽回頭一看 說醬咧 醬去哪了

[Pre-Chorus]
隔壁借走 又被隔壁的隔壁借走
兒子 去把醬拿回來

[Chorus - Call and Response]
烤肉醬 借一下 (借一下)
從巷頭 一路問到巷尾
每一家 都說剛剛還在
烤肉醬 借一下 整條巷子同一罐

[Verse 2]
王家的香腸 硬塞兩根給我
林家的小孩 頭上戴著柚子皮
樓下的黃狗 在桌子底下等肉片
月亮好圓 可是沒有人在看

[Pre-Chorus]
最後在巷尾 找到那一罐
我一擠 只剩下一滴

[Chorus - Call and Response]
烤肉醬 借一下 (借一下)
空罐子 我拿回去交差
我媽笑一笑 說沒關係
明年 我們先買三罐

[Outro - synth stabs and hand claps]
借一下 借一下
月亮 你要不要也來一串

烤肉醬 借一下 整條巷子同一罐
[Verse 2]
王家的香腸 硬塞兩根給我
林家的小孩 頭上戴著柚子皮
樓下的黃狗 在桌子底下等肉片
月亮好圓 可是沒有人在看
[Pre-Chorus]
最後在巷尾 找到那一罐
我一擠 只剩下一滴
[Chorus - Call and Response]
烤肉醬 借一下 (借一下)
空罐子 我拿回去交差
我媽笑一笑 說沒關係
明年 我們先買三罐
[Outro - synth stabs and hand claps]
借一下 借一下
月亮 你要不要也來一串

tracks.title: 船不開了
tracks.subject: three friends stuck on Green Island for two extra days under a cloudless sky when the ferries stop for swells from a typhoon far out at sea
tracks.caption: Mandarin Afropop on a South African amapiano groove. A deep percussive log drum bass playing syncopated slides; a laid-back house kick with off-beat shakers and wood-block percussion; jazzy Rhodes electric piano chords; a soft breathy flute-like synth pad answering the vocal; light congas. Spacious sunny mix, round warm low end, crisp light percussion. Male baritone, relaxed and half-spoken in the verses, with a soft female harmony on the chorus. 113 BPM, A-flat major. Sun-dazed, lazy and quietly gleeful. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drop, no reggaeton dembow, no straight four-on-the-floor jazz-house groove, no rap verse.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - log drum and shakers]

[Verse 1]
早上九點 碼頭的鐵門拉下來
公告上寫 浪太大 今天停航
天空藍到 一片雲都沒有
颱風在好遠的海上 我們根本看不到

[Pre-Chorus]
小美打給老闆 聲音裝得好可憐
阿哲已經跑去 機車多租一天

[Chorus - Female Harmony]
船不開了 船不開了
回不去了 沒辦法嘛
再一碗海草冰 再住一晚民宿
船不開了 大家不要急

[Verse 2]
傍晚去泡 海邊的溫泉
梅花鹿在路邊 盯著我們的便當
手機說 明天浪還是一樣
我們三個 忍不住一直笑

[Pre-Chorus]
老闆傳來一句 好啦好啦
回來記得 帶伴手禮

[Chorus - Female Harmony]
船不開了 船還是不開
回不去了 好可惜喔
再一碗海草冰 再數一晚星星
船不開了 大家不要急

[Outro - log drum and shakers fading]
第三天 船開了
我們在碼頭 走得好慢

tracks.title: 你掉的是這一把嗎
tracks.subject: a clerk at a metro station lost-and-found who logs four hundred umbrellas a week beside false teeth, a guitar and a bag of live crabs, and a retired man who asks every Tuesday after the same old watch
tracks.caption: Mandarin piano rock in the guitarless Taiwanese piano-trio style. A hard-hit acoustic grand piano pounding chords in the left hand with fast right-hand runs; a fuzzy overdriven electric bass playing the riffs a guitar would; loud open live drums with crash cymbals and tom fills; a toy glockenspiel doubling the chorus melody. Raw live-room recording, piano bright and up front, gritty bass, roomy drums. Female mezzo-alto, clear and wry, talking through the verses and belting the chorus with a slight rasp. 138 BPM, B-flat major. Wry, brisk and warm-hearted. No electric guitar, no ballad slowdown, no autotune, no EDM synths, no trap drums.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - pounding piano chords and drum fill]

[Verse 1]
捷運站 地下二樓 失物招領
一張桌子 一台電腦 一本登記簿
這禮拜 收了四百一十二把傘
一副假牙 一把吉他 一袋還在動的螃蟹

[Pre-Chorus]
有人衝進來 喘著氣 說他掉了東西
我把手 放在那一排傘上面

[Chorus]
你掉的是金的 還是銀的
還是這一把 透明的塑膠傘
不要急 慢慢說 它長什麼樣子
你掉的 是這一把嗎

[Verse 2]
有個阿伯 每個禮拜二都來
問一支黑色的舊錶 有沒有人撿到
我每次都說 再等等看
他每次都說 好 那我下禮拜再來

[Pre-Chorus]
今天下午 它躺在雜物箱的最底下
指針還在走 比我上班還準時

[Chorus]
你掉的是金的 還是銀的
還是這一支 等了三個月的錶
阿伯笑著說 金的銀的都不要
你掉的 就是這一支吧

[Outro - piano runs and crashing cymbals]
四百一十二把傘
還在等 下一場雨
